sources.summary: The project marks the beginning of agence ontwerp's work on highlighting 1960s heritage. It redesigns an apartment on the seventh floor of a gallery-flat building in Rotterdam , designed by Harry Nefkens in 1958. This type of property is often overlooked in favor of nearby buildings that are older and perceived as more charming.
